summary: Get the state of the country rules

200.description: Whether country rules can be saved and used

available.description: Whether a usable GeoIP country database (or a custom geoip_country directive) exists

custom_directive.description: Whether a custom geoip_country directive in the custom nginx files takes over

lists_with_rules.description: Number of the access lists the user can see that have a country mode other than off

description:
Tells whether country rules can be saved: a GeoIP country database of the active provider is usable or a custom geoip_country directive exists. Also counts the visible access lists with a country mode on.

Needs: Access Lists view
